steps: Step:1 Set a cable pulley to upper-chest height and attach a rope handle.
Step:2 Grip the rope with thumbs toward you and palms facing each other.
Step:3 Step back until arms are extended and there is light tension on the cable.
Step:4 Stand tall with feet hip-width, brace your core, and keep shoulders down.
Step:5 Pull the rope toward your forehead or upper nose while driving elbows out and back.
Step:6 Squeeze rear delts and upper back for one second without shrugging.
Step:7 Return slowly with control until arms are nearly straight.
Step:8 Repeat for reps, keeping wrists neutral and torso stable.
Step:1 Hang from the bar with hands slightly wider than shoulders, palms away or neutral.
Step:2 Depress your shoulder blades and brace your core.
Step:3 Pull your chest toward the bar by driving elbows down and back.
Step:4 Pause briefly at the top with chin near bar height.
Step:5 Lower under control to a full hang without swinging.
Step:1 Lie on the bench with eyes under the bar, feet flat on the floor.
Step:2 Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulders and unrack to arm's length.
Step:3 Lower the bar to mid-chest with elbows at roughly 45 degrees.
Step:4 Press the bar up in a slight arc until arms are extended.
Step:5 Keep shoulder blades retracted and wrists stacked over elbows.
Step:1 Set the bar on upper traps, feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out.
Step:2 Brace your core and take a breath before descending.
Step:3 Sit hips back and down while keeping chest up and knees tracking over toes.
Step:4 Reach at least parallel depth with a neutral spine.
Step:5 Drive through mid-foot to stand, exhaling near the top.
Step:1 Stand with mid-foot under the bar, feet hip-width.
Step:2 Hinge and grip the bar just outside your legs.
Step:3 Pull slack out of the bar, flatten your back, and brace your core.
Step:4 Drive the floor away and keep the bar close to your legs.
Step:5 Stand tall at lockout without hyperextending your lower back.
Step:6 Hinge back down with control to reset each rep.
